name: PlayStation 5 Slim Digital Edition
summary: Disc-free PS5 Slim. Leaves more of a tight budget for a screen or headset. GTA 6 is a digital purchase on this model.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: PlayStation 5 Slim Disc Edition
summary: PS5 Slim with a 4K Blu-ray drive. The sample catalog treats this as the cinematic PS5 because it also plays discs.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: Xbox Series X
summary: Flagship Xbox in this sample catalog. 4K target and a disc drive. The right Series console when the screen budget can survive a $499 box.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: Xbox Series S
summary: Smallest Xbox that runs the Series generation. Digital only, and the storage is tight for a game the size of GTA 6, so pair it with the expansion card if you can.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: LG C4 42-inch OLED TV
summary: 42-inch OLED. The sample catalog's premium cinematic screen: high contrast for night driving, and still small enough for a desk.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: TCL QM7 55-inch TV
summary: 55-inch mini-LED in the sample catalog. The mid cinematic pick when an OLED does not fit the screen allocation.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: Sony Bravia X90L 55-inch TV
summary: 55-inch full-array LED. A cinematic living-room panel in the sample catalog, priced between the TCL and the OLED.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: Samsung Odyssey G6 27-inch
summary: 27-inch 240 Hz QHD monitor. Strong competitive pick. GTA 6 itself will not run at 240 fps on a console; the headroom is for other games.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: LG UltraGear 27GP850-B
summary: 27-inch 180 Hz QHD monitor. A mid competitive screen in the sample catalog.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: Dell G2724D 27-inch
summary: 27-inch 165 Hz QHD monitor. The value competitive screen once the console has taken the first slice of the budget.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: AOC 24G4 24-inch
summary: 24-inch 165 Hz 1080p monitor. The cheapest display in the sample catalog. Fine for a desk, small for a cinematic open world.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: PlayStation Pulse Elite
summary: PS5 wireless headset with a planar magnetic driver. Not an Xbox headset. Sits just over the $100 line in this sample catalog.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7
summary: Wireless headset that works on both consoles and PC. The sample catalog's default long-session pick when the budget is not chasing a specialist.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: HyperX Cloud III
summary: Wired headset under $100 in this sample catalog. Comfortable for long sessions and works on both consoles.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

summary: Top competitive headset in the sample catalog. Graphene drivers, wireless. Worth it when the headset allocation is large.

name: Xbox Wireless Controller
summary: Standard Xbox pad. The carry-over controller for a PC-later plan because it already works on PC and Xbox.

name: Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2
summary: Xbox pro pad with paddles and swappable parts. Competitive upgrade for Series consoles and PC.
sampleNote: Sample price for this demo. Not a live retail quote.

name: Samsung 990 EVO 2 TB
